title: Open Counter card v1
description: A small shop described so any AI shopping agent can read it, check delivery and start a PayPal checkout that a person approves. Published at /c/<slug>.json and listed at /.well-known/open-counter.json.

maker.description: The person who makes and ships the goods

ships_to.description: Country code; Open Counter v1 ships inside the US

made_to_order.description: Rules for builds that aren't on the shelf: price, discounts, build time, what to ask

payment.description: Always: the buyer approves every order in PayPal; agents can't pay

mcp.description: MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP) with the shop's tools

paypal_catalog_product.description: The item's id in the maker's PayPal Catalog Products (null until registered)
